title: Particles
summary: Make a fountain of sparks with the Particles behavior: how many, how fast, which way, and how they fall and fade.

steps.title: Welcome
steps.text: The Particles behavior sends out copies of an instance that are born, fly, fall, spin and fade: sparks, snow, bubbles, confetti. It plays the same every time, so it renders the same as it previews.

steps.title: Select the spark
steps.text: Press V for the Selection tool and click the spark on the stage.

steps.title: Open the Behaviors panel
steps.text: Choose Window > Behaviors if it is not showing. It lists what is on the selection and the settings of each.

steps.title: Play it
steps.text: Press Enter, or click the play button in the timeline header. Sparks shoot up, slow, and fall back as they shrink and fade.

steps.title: A taller fountain
steps.text: Set Speed to 500 and Spread to 20. The sparks go higher in a narrower jet.

steps.title: More of them
steps.text: Set Born per second to 80 and Life to 3 seconds.

steps.title: Snow instead
steps.text: For snow, set Direction to 90 (down), Born across to 1280, Gravity to 0 and Turbulence to 30, and move the spark to the top of the stage.

steps.title: Well done
steps.text:
You made a fountain with one instance and one behavior. A movie clip or a graphic with a loop works as a particle too: each one plays its loop from when it is born.

Effector after Particles changes them by where they are: brighten those near a point, say.
